lines.tts: Hello everyone! We're Group 14, Team Sweet Potatoes.
lines.sub: Hello everyone! We're Group 14, Team Sweet Potatoes.

lines.tts: Our project explores how to help international residents take part in local government decisions.
lines.sub: Our project explores how to help international residents take part in local government decisions.

lines.tts: During our investigation, we found five problems.
lines.sub: During our investigation, we found five problems.

lines.tts: First, policy terms are hard to understand, so residents lose confidence when sharing their opinions.
lines.sub: First, policy terms are hard to understand, so residents lose confidence when sharing their opinions.

lines.tts: Second, it's hard to attend in-person discussions with a busy daily life.
lines.sub: Second, it's hard to attend in-person discussions with a busy daily life.

lines.tts: Third, topics that don't feel personally relevant get less attention.
lines.sub: Third, topics that don't feel personally relevant get less attention.

lines.tts: Fourth, residents get stuck finding the right department.
lines.sub: Fourth, residents get stuck finding the right department.

lines.tts: And last, newer residents rely on social media, but official information is mostly shared through physical channels.
lines.sub: And last, newer residents rely on social media, but official information is mostly shared through physical channels.

lines.tts: Meet Jason. He's 34, an immigrant from Taiwan, and he has lived in Melbourne for eight years.
lines.sub: Meet Jason. He's 34, an immigrant from Taiwan, and he has lived in Melbourne for eight years.

lines.tts: He has a dog and works full time, so he can't attend council meetings.
lines.sub: He has a dog and works full time, so he can't attend council meetings.

lines.tts: One morning, he finds a flyer in his mailbox: the dog park will no longer open in the mornings.
lines.sub: One morning, he finds a flyer in his mailbox: the dog park will no longer open in the mornings.

lines.tts: He disagrees with the new policy, but he doesn't know who to send his opinion to, or whether he's expressing it correctly.
lines.sub: He disagrees with the new policy, but he doesn't know who to send his opinion to, or whether he's expressing it correctly.

lines.tts: The last time he emailed the council, he never heard back.
lines.sub: The last time he emailed the council, he never heard back.

lines.tts: So we introduce HearHere: a street pillar paired with a mobile app, with a customised AI helper inside.
lines.sub: So we introduce HearHere: a street pillar paired with a mobile app, with a customised AI helper inside.

lines.tts: Let's see what Jason can do with HearHere.
lines.sub: Let's see what Jason can do with HearHere.

lines.tts: On his way to the park, Jason walks past a HearHere pillar.
lines.sub: On his way to the park, Jason walks past a HearHere pillar.

lines.tts: He taps the touch screen and finds the dog park issue among the decisions near him.
lines.sub: He taps the touch screen and finds the dog park issue among the decisions near him.

lines.tts: The content is shown in Traditional Chinese, and difficult terms are explained simply.
lines.sub: The content is shown in Traditional Chinese, and difficult terms are explained simply.

lines.tts: Then Jason talks to the AI helper in Mandarin.
lines.sub: Then Jason talks to the AI helper in Mandarin.

lines.tts: 希望可以保留早上的遛狗時間。
lines.sub: Please keep the morning dog walking hours.
lines.phonemes: ɕi→wa↘ŋ kʰɤ↗i↓ pau↓ljou↗ ʦau↓ʂa↘ŋ tɤ ljou↘kou↓ ʂɻ↗ʨjɛ→n.

lines.tts: It turns his opinion into a clear English comment, and tells him which department is responsible.
lines.sub: It turns his opinion into a clear English comment, and tells him which department is responsible.

lines.tts: Jason can check and edit the comment before sending, and his voice is never recorded.
lines.sub: Jason can check and edit the comment before sending, and his voice is never recorded.

lines.tts: After that, Jason taps his phone on the N F C connector, and the issue moves to the HearHere app.
lines.sub: After that, Jason taps his phone on the NFC connector, and the issue moves to the HearHere app.

lines.tts: The pillar keeps none of his information.
lines.sub: The pillar keeps none of his information.

lines.tts: In the app, he can track his comment: from received, to in review, and finally the result, with a case number, or the reasons if it's declined.
lines.sub: In the app, he can track his comment: from received, to in review, and finally the result, with a case number, or the reasons if it's declined.

lines.tts: He can also share the issue on Instagram, so his neighbours can join in.
lines.sub: He can also share the issue on Instagram, so his neighbours can join in.

lines.tts: With HearHere, Jason can understand the policy in his own language, find the right department, and know his opinion has been received, all without attending a meeting.
lines.sub: With HearHere, Jason can understand the policy in his own language, find the right department, and know his opinion has been received, all without attending a meeting.

lines.tts: However, HearHere still has limits.
lines.sub: However, HearHere still has limits.

lines.tts: Speaking to a device in public may feel uncomfortable, and the AI may make mistakes when translating.
lines.sub: Speaking to a device in public may feel uncomfortable, and the AI may make mistakes when translating.

lines.tts: So in the future, we need to test whether residents feel comfortable speaking in public, whether translations keep their meaning, and whether people without smartphones can still use HearHere.
lines.sub: So in the future, we need to test whether residents feel comfortable speaking in public, whether translations keep their meaning, and whether people without smartphones can still use HearHere.

lines.tts: We also need to understand how the council would manage and respond to feedback, so residents can trust that their voices are heard.
lines.sub: We also need to understand how the council would manage and respond to feedback, so residents can trust that their voices are heard.

lines.tts: HearHere: the street pillar for understanding local decisions.
lines.sub: HearHere: the street pillar for understanding local decisions.
